workflow: Manual import of customer data from spreadsheets into CRM after each marketing campaign
trigger: New marketing campaign ends, generating leads in a CSV file
current_workaround: Hiring freelancers on Upwork to manually copy-paste rows from CSV into CRM fields, one by one
consequence: Delayed follow-up with leads, inconsistent data entry (missing fields, duplicates), customer frustration from late responses

workflow: Weekly reconciliation of customer orders between Shopify and QuickBooks using manual cross-checking
trigger: End of week, order totals in Shopify and QuickBooks don't match
current_workaround: Posting short-term contracts on Upwork for a data entry freelancer to export both system reports, compare line by line, and adjust journal entries
consequence: Payroll errors, inventory discrepancies, accounting adjustments taking hours, risk of audit flags

workflow: Manual email follow-up sequence for customer onboarding – copying templates, updating status in Google Sheets
trigger: New customer signs up for the SaaS product
current_workaround: Hiring a virtual assistant on Upwork to manually send personalized emails from Gmail, track replies in a spreadsheet, and update the company's CRM when a customer moves to the next stage
consequence: Inconsistent onboarding experience, missed follow-ups, low activation rates, no visibility into where each customer is in the process

workflow: Manual migration of customer data from legacy CRM (Zoho) to Salesforce requiring field mapping and deduplication
trigger: Company decided to switch CRM platforms, but built-in import tool fails to handle custom fields
current_workaround: Hiring an Upwork freelancer with SQL skills to write scripts to extract, transform, and load data, plus manual verification of each record
consequence: Data loss, corrupt records, duplicate contacts, weeks of delays, customer service disruption during migration

workflow: Manual generation of customer KYC reports for financial audits using Excel pivot tables and copy-paste from multiple systems
trigger: Quarterly audit or new customer onboarding requiring identity verification
current_workaround: Posting a recurring job on Upwork for a data analyst to pull customer data from banking core, AML screening tool, and CRM, then manually compile a PDF report with screenshots
consequence: Non-compliance fines, missed reporting deadlines, inconsistent data quality, high cost of freelance labor each month
